title: A note of only spaces records no note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, active.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SPACES PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPACES-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPACES-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL SPACES PART).
  3. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] is on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [Part-A], pick "Inactive" and click Save.
  2. Type five spaces in the note field.
  3. Click "Deactivate".
  4. Open [Part-A]'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The change is accepted and [Part-A] moves to the Inactive tab.
  • Step 4: The newest entry reads "Deactivated" and nothing more (no "| Reason:").
